name: sleep attack
description: Puts an enemy to sleep for 3 turns.
effect: Deals physical damage to one target and inflicts Sleep with a 100% base chance for three turns.

name: silence attack
description: Silences an enemy for 3 turns.
effect: Deals physical damage to one target and inflicts Silence with a 100% base chance for three turns.

name: dark attack
description: Inflicts darkness on an enemy for 3 turns.
effect: Deals physical damage to one target and inflicts Darkness with a 100% base chance for three turns.

name: sleep buster
description: Almost always puts an enemy to sleep for 1 turn.
effect: Deals physical damage to one target and always inflicts Sleep for one turn unless it is immune.

name: silence buster
description: Almost always silences an enemy for 1 turn.
effect: Deals physical damage to one target and always inflicts Silence for one turn unless it is immune.

name: dark buster
description: Almost always inflicts darkness on an enemy for 1 turn.
effect: Deals physical damage to one target and always inflicts Darkness for one turn unless it is immune.

name: zombie attack
description: Inflicts an enemy with zombie status.
effect: Deals physical damage to one target and inflicts Zombie with a 100% base chance.

name: triple foul
description: Sleep, silence, and darkness on an enemy for 3 turns.
effect: Deals physical damage to one target and inflicts Darkness, Silence, and Sleep with a 100% base chance each for three turns.

name: delay attack
description: Delays action of an enemy.
effect: Deals physical damage to one target and causes weak Delay.

name: delay buster
description: Greatly delays action of an enemy.
effect: Deals physical damage to one target and causes strong Delay.

name: extract power
description: Makes one enemy drop Power Spheres.
effect: Deals physical damage to one target. Causes an enemy to drop Power Spheres. The number of dropped Spheres is equal to the number of items the enemy would have dropped normally.

name: extract mana
description: Makes one enemy drop Mana Spheres.
effect: Deals physical damage to one target. Causes an enemy to drop Mana Spheres. The number of dropped Spheres is equal to the number of items the enemy would have dropped normally.

name: extract speed
description: Makes one enemy drop Speed Spheres.
effect: Deals physical damage to one target. Causes an enemy to drop Speed Spheres. The number of dropped Spheres is equal to the number of items the enemy would have dropped normally.

name: extract ability
description: Makes one enemy drop Ability Spheres.
effect: Deals physical damage to one target. Causes an enemy to drop Ability Spheres. The number of dropped Spheres is equal to the number of items the enemy would have dropped normally.

name: power break
description: Lowers an enemy's Strength.
effect: Deals physical damage to one target and inflicts Power Break on it with a 100% base chance.

name: magic break
description: Lowers an enemy's Magic.
effect: Deals physical damage to one target and inflicts Magic Break on it with a 100% base chance.

name: armor break
description: Lowers an enemy's Defense and nullifies armored.
effect: Deals physical damage to one target and inflicts Armor Break on it with a 100% base chance.

name: mental break
description: Lowers an enemy's Magic Defense.
effect: Deals physical damage to one target and inflicts Mental Break on it with a 100% base chance.

name: full break
description: Inflicts Power, Magic, Armor, and Mental Break.
effect: Deals physical damage to one target and inflicts Power Break, Magic Break, Armor Break, and Mental Break on it with a 100% base chance each.

name: mug
description: Steals items and damages one enemy.
effect: Deals physical damage to one enemy and attempts to Steal from it. The chance of success is halved with each successful steal.

name: nab gil
description: Attack and steal gil at the same time.
effect: Deals physical damage to one enemy and steals Gil from it. The chance of success is halved with each successful steal.

name: quick hit
description: Strike quickly with reduced recovery time.
effect: Deals physical damage to one target. Is faster than a normal Attack.

name: steal
description: Steal items from enemy.
effect: Attempts to Steal an item from an enemy. The chance of success is halved with each successful steal.

name: use
description: Use special items.
effect: Opens the Use-Item menu.

name: flee
description: Aid party's escape from battle.
effect: Causes entire party to immediately Escape from battle without fail.

name: pray
description: Restores some HP to all allies.
effect: Restores a very small amount of HP of party. Deals damage to Zombies.

name: cheer
description: Raises party's Strength and Defense.
effect: Raises the party's Strength by 1 and reduces their buff-factor, a factor used in the defensive formula, for strength-based attacks by 1/15 for the duration of the battle (removed if KO'd). Can be stacked up to five times (stacks additively). Effect goes away when KO'd.

name: aim
description: Raises party's Accuracy.
effect: Adds 10% to the party's final hit rate for the duration of the battle (removed if KO'd). Can be stacked up to five times and also stacks with the Luck Ability (stacks additively in all cases). Effect goes away when KO'd.

name: focus
description: Raises party's Magic and Magic Defense.
effect: Raises the party's Magic by 1 and reduces their buff-factor, a factor used in the defensive formula, for magic-based attacks by 1/15 for the duration of the battle (removed if KO'd). Can be stacked up to five times (stacks additively). Effect goes away when KO'd.

name: reflex
description: Raises party's Evasion.
effect: Adds 10% to the party's final evasion rate for the duration of the battle (removed if KO'd). Can be stacked up to five times (stacks additively). Effect goes away when KO'd.

name: luck
description: Raises party's Luck.
effect: Adds 1% to the party's final hit rate and critical hit rate for the duration of the battle (removed if KO'd). Can be stacked up to five times and also stacks with the Aim Ability (stacks additively in all cases). Effect goes away when KO'd.

name: jinx
description: Lowers all enemies' Luck.
effect: Subtracts 1% from all enemy's final evasion rate and critical hit defense rate for the duration of the battle. Can be stacked up to five times (stacks additively).

name: lancet
description: Absorb HP & MP from an enemy.
effect: Absorbs a small amount of HP and MP from one enemy and gives it to the user (effect is reversed if the enemy is a Zombie). If used by Kimahri, he will also learn an enemy's Ronso Rage, and if he does so, gets a full Overdrive Gauge.

name: guard
description: Take damage for an ally.
effect: Causes the user to intercept all single-target physical attacks directed towards the party until the user's next turn.

name: sentinel
description: Guard allies while in defensive stance.
effect: Causes the user to enter Defend status and intercept all single-target physical attacks directed towards the party until the user's next turn.

name: spare change
description: Attack by throwing gil.
effect: Allows you to choose an amount of Gil to throw at an enemy. Every 10 Gil thrown will increase the damage dealt by 1 point.

name: threaten
description: Immobilize an enemy with fear.
effect: Inflicts Threaten status on one enemy, preventing it from acting until the user's next turn. CTB altering actions like Haste, Slow, or Delay will fail on the user until their turn.

name: provoke
description: Draw an enemy's attacks towards you.
effect: Inflicts Provoke status on one enemy, forcing it to use a specific move to attack the user.

name: entrust
description: Contribute your Overdrive charge to an ally's gauge.
effect: Transfers user's entire Overdrive gauge to another character.

name: copycat
description: Mimic an ally's previous action.
effect: Causes the character to mimic the previous action of another character, if it can be mimicked.

name: pilfer gil
description: Steal gil from an enemy.
effect: Attempts to Steal Gil from an enemy. The chance of success is halved with each successful steal.

name: quick pockets
description: Swiftly use items.
effect: Use an item. Is faster than the Item command.

name: doublecast
description: Cast two black magic spells in a row.
effect: Allows the user to cast two Blk Magic spells during the same turn. The rank of these abilities is ignored. Doublecast will always be a rank 3 action.

name: bribe
description: Pay enemies gil to go away.
effect: Attempts to pay an enemy to get it to leave the battle. Bribed enemies are considered defeated and will give Items based upon their Bribe information and the amount of money given. The required amount of Gil is a multiple of the enemy's HP. HP x10 = 25% success rate, HP x15 = 50%, HP x20 = 75%, HP x25 = 100%. If the attempt is unsuccessful, the spent amount is still stored for the monster type, and every additional attempt on a monster of the same type will add to that total until the bribe succeeds.

name: cure
description: Restores some HP.
effect: Restores a small amount of HP to one target. Damages Zombies.

name: cura
description: Restores a lot of HP.
effect: Restores a moderate amount of HP to one target. Damages Zombies.

name: curaga
description: Restores a massive amount of HP.
effect: Restores a large amount of HP to one target. Damages Zombies.

name: nulblaze
description: Nullifies one fire attack on party.
effect: Grants NulBlaze to party.

name: nulshock
description: Nullifies one lightning attack on party.
effect: Grants NulShock to party.

name: nultide
description: Nullifies one water attack on party.
effect: Grants NulTide to party.

name: nulfrost
description: Nullifies one ice attack on party.
effect: Grants NulFrost to party.

name: scan
description: View an enemy's data.
effect: Shows detailed information about a target, including HP, elemental weaknesses, current statuses, and a detailed description. After scanning, information for the scanned enemy will be shown as if you had a Sensor-Weapon equipped.

name: esuna
description: Cures a character's status ailments.
effect: Cures all status ailments of one target, except KO, Doom, Curse, and the Breaks.

name: life
description: Revives a KO'd character.
effect: Revives a KO'd character with half of their max HP. Can kill Zombies. Deals 50% of a Zombie's max HP as damage if it is immune to Life (maximum damage = damage limit).

name: full-life
description: Revives a KO'd character and fully restores HP.
effect: Revives a KO'd character with half of their max HP. Can kill Zombies. Deals 100% of a Zombie's max HP as damage if it is immune to Life (maximum damage = damage limit).

name: haste
description: Speeds up one character.
effect: Grants Haste status to one target.

name: hastega
description: Speeds up party.
effect: Grants Haste status to party.

name: slow
description: Slows an enemy down.
effect: Inflicts Slow status on one target.

name: slowga
description: Slows all enemies down.
effect: Inflicts Slow status on target party.

name: shell
description: Raises a character's Magic Defense.
effect: Grants Shell status to one target.

name: protect
description: Raises a character's Defense.
effect: Grants Protect status to one target.

name: reflect
description: Target reflects spells towards enemy.
effect: Grants Reflect status to one target.

name: dispel
description: Negates all spell effects on an enemy.
effect: Removes all positive status effects except Auto-Life from one target. Also removes the Breaks and Curse.

name: regen
description: Target gradually recovers HP for a time.
effect: Grants Regen status to one target.

name: holy
description: Deals holy damage to an enemy.
effect: Deals heavy holy elemental magic damage to one target.

name: auto-life
description: Target is automatically revived once when KO'd.
effect: Grants Auto-Life status to one target.

name: auto-life

damage_calc.condition: When character with auto-life status is KO'd.

effect: Revives a KO'd character with a quarter of their max HP.

name: nulall
effect: Grants NulBlaze, NulShock, NulTide, and NulFrost to party.

name: fire
description: Deals fire damage to an enemy.
effect: Deals light fire-elemental magic damage to one target.

name: thunder
description: Deals lightning damage to an enemy.
effect: Deals light lightning-elemental magic damage to one target.

name: water
description: Deals water damage to an enemy.
effect: Deals light water-elemental magic damage to one target.

name: blizzard
description: Deals ice damage to an enemy.
effect: Deals light ice-elemental magic damage to one target.

name: fira
description: Deals fire damage to an enemy.
effect: Deals moderate fire-elemental magic damage to one target.

name: thundara
description: Deals lightning damage to an enemy.
effect: Deals moderate lightning-elemental magic damage to one target.

name: watera
description: Deals water damage to an enemy.
effect: Deals moderate water-elemental magic damage to one target.

name: blizzara
description: Deals ice damage to an enemy.
effect: Deals moderate ice-elemental magic damage to one target.

name: firaga
description: Deals fire damage to an enemy.
effect: Deals heavy fire-elemental magic damage to one target.

name: thundaga
description: Deals lightning damage to an enemy.
effect: Deals heavy lightning-elemental magic damage to one target.

name: waterga
description: Deals water damage to an enemy.
effect: Deals heavy water-elemental magic damage to one target.

name: blizzaga
description: Deals ice damage to an enemy.
effect: Deals heavy ice-elemental magic damage to one target.

name: bio
description: Poisons an enemy.
effect: Inflicts Poison on one target. Always succeeds, unless the target is immune.

name: demi
description: Reduces HP of all enemies by 1/4.
effect: Reduces target party's HP to 75% of their current HP.

name: death
description: Can instantly KO an enemy.
effect: Inflicts Instant KO on one enemy with 100% base accuracy. Fails against Zombies.

name: drain
description: Absorb HP from an enemy.
effect: Absorbs HP from one target and heals the caster's HP for the amount of damage dealt. Effect is reversed against Zombies.

name: osmose
description: Absorb MP from an enemy.
effect: Absorbs MP from one target and heals the caster's MP for the amount of damage dealt. Effect is reversed against Zombies.

name: flare
description: Deals non-elemental damage to an enemy.
effect: Deals heavy non-elemental magic damage to one target.

name: ultima
description: Deals non-elemental damage to an enemy.
effect: Deals heavy non-elemental magic damage to target party.

name: sonic wings
description: Damages an enemy and delays its turn.
effect: Deals unblockable ranged physical damage and weak Delay to one enemy.

name: meteor strike
description: Damages an enemy.
effect: Deals unblockable ranged special damage to one enemy.

name: aerospark
description: Damages an enemy and negates all spell effects.
effect: Deals unblockable ranged physical damage to one enemy and removes all positive status effects from it.

name: heavenly strike
description: Deals unblockable ranged physical damage to one enemy and inflicts Threaten.
effect: Damages an enemy and delays its movement.

name: impulse
description: Damages all enemies.
effect: Deals unblockable ranged physical damage to all enemies.

name: pain
description: Deals damage and Death to an enemy.
effect: Deals magical damage to one enemy and always inflicts Death on it unless it is immune.

name: daigoro
effect: Deals physical damage to one enemy.

name: kozuka
effect: Deals physical damage to one enemy.

name: wakizashi
effect: Deals physical damage to one enemy.

name: wakizashi
effect: Deals physical damage to all enemies.

name: zanmato
effect: Inflicts Death on all enemies, ignoring immunities.

name: camisade
effect: Deals physical damage to one enemy.

name: razzia
effect: Deals physical damage to one enemy.

name: passado
effect: Deals 15 hits of physical damage to one enemy.

name: taking a break...
effect: The user does nothing, essentially skipping their turn.
